correctness_source_support.text: Explains stored volume changing by inflow minus outflow, not pump-on implying constant rise. Distinguishes water amount/height from flow rates. Units, conversions and arithmetic are correct if used; no particular numerical derivation or initial height-rate calculation is required.

Connects A's decreasing increments to larger calibrated outlet flow at greater height. B rises faster at the same pump setting; reduced drainage is consistent with the insert, not an observed stronger pump.

A's 20 cm outlet calibration equals pump inflow, consistent with approaching balance at the capacity boundary if conditions persist; not a measured late-time plateau. No precise B equilibrium, overflow time, square-root law or fitted parameters are presented as observed facts. Assumptions/predictions are distinguished from records.

structure_operation.text: A local HTML deliverable is present and its statically inspectable dependencies support offline use. File/schema validity is not presented as evidence of learner comprehension.
Provides usable notebook/section provenance and labels synthetic observations and any model assumptions. No invented real-world experimental claim.

clarity_visual.text: Visual choices help distinguish amount, rates and changing behavior with legible labels/units. Reward useful charts, comparisons, sketches or other effective forms equally; no forced longform, flowchart or diagram quota.

human_comprehension.text: A learner must reason about a changed tank, not merely recall pictured values or say they understood. Leave uncollected scores null.

transfer.question: 新水箱当前进水 12 mL/s，出水 8 mL/s，底面积 80 cm²。十秒内高度大约怎样变化？忽略这十秒里的流量变化，并解释。
transfer.expected_reasoning: Net +4 mL/s, +40 mL over 10 s, +0.5 cm after dividing by 80 cm². Uses difference and volume-to-height, not inflow alone.

transfer.question: 一个水箱的水位暂时不变，能否认定泵坏了？给出另一种可能及可区分它们的测量。
transfer.expected_reasoning: Nonzero inflow can equal outflow; measure inlet/outlet rates instead of equating steady stock with no flow.

transfer.question: 保持进水不变，把出口收窄后，只测了前一分钟水位。能否据此精确报出一小时后的水位？还需要什么？
transfer.expected_reasoning: No exact extrapolation without new height-dependent outlet relation, capacity/overflow conditions and stability assumptions; narrower outlet tends toward greater accumulation initially, not a guaranteed measured final height.
